title: LESSRec: Level-Specific History Modeling for Semantic ID-Based Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Semantic ID-based recommendation represents each item as a sequence of semantic tokens obtained through residual quantization. This paradigm generates the next item's tokens autoregressively from coarse to fine, entailing each prediction attending to historical tokens at all semantic levels. However, our inference-time analysis reveals that historical tokens at the target-token's semantic level tend to be more informative, whereas other levels can introduce interference. Motivated by these findings, we propose LESSRec that separately encodes the historical token sequence at each semantic level and restricts attention over historical tokens to the sequence at the target token's semantic level during prediction. To complement these level-specific histories, LESSRec explicitly provides an item-level semantic sequence that represents each historical item's overall semantics in chronological order. The decoder accesses the level-aligned token

translated_title: LESSRec：面向基于语义ID推荐的层级特定历史建模
translated_abstract: 基于语义ID的推荐通过残差量化将每个物品表示为一个语义标记序列。该范式以自回归方式从粗到细地生成下一个物品的标记，要求每次预测都关注所有语义层级的历史标记。然而，我们的推理时分析发现，与目标标记处于同一语义层级的历史标记往往更具信息量，而其他层级的历史标记可能引入干扰。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了LESSRec，它分别编码每个语义层级的历史标记序列，并在预测时将对历史标记的注意力限制在目标标记所在语义层级的序列上。为了补充这些层级特定的历史信息，LESSRec还显式提供了一个物品级语义序列，按时间顺序表示每个历史物品的整体语义。解码器通过访问层级对齐的标记……
tldr: LESSRec通过按语义层级分别编码历史标记序列，并将预测时的注意力限制在目标标记所在层级，同时辅以按时间顺序排列的物品级语义序列，从而提升基于语义ID的推荐效果。
en_tdlr: LESSRec enhances semantic ID-based recommendation by separately encoding historical tokens at each semantic level, restricting attention to the target token's level during prediction, and complementing this with a chronological item-level semantic sequence.
